channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: South Korea says US-North Korea talks possible, rules out Hormuz deployment
item.description: South Korean president will facilitate US-North Korea talks but will not deploy troops in US war on Iran.

item.title: Fire engulfs Zaporizhzhia shopping centre after Russian strike
item.description: A Russian strike hit a shopping centre in Zaporizhzhia, southeastern Ukraine, sparking a major fire.

item.title: UN findings show US strikes on Minab could be war crimes
item.description: UN-backed human rights experts say the US committed possible war crimes when it launched two strikes.

item.title: Iran expels Swedish diplomat in retaliatory move
item.description: Tehran gives Swedish official 48 hours to leave as Iran says Stockholm is bowing down to outside pressure.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump weighs ‘big decision’ on Iran, tanker hit in Hormuz
item.description: Trump says he faces a 'big decision' on whether to 'annihilate' his Iranian foes, adding that 'anything could happen'.

item.title: Migrant sea crossings to Europe drop sharply as deaths rise: IOM
item.description: More than 2,200 migrants died or vanished at sea in 2026, despite declining crossings into Europe, says IOM.

item.title: Trump administration approves sale of F-35 jets to Saudi Arabia
item.description: The deal, which needs approval from Congress, comes as Riyadh seeks Washington's help in its war with Yemen's Houthis.

item.title: US approves visas for top Iranian leaders to attend UN General Assembly
item.description: Iran's delegation to UNGA will be smaller this year, with travel restrictions and limits on luxury goods purchases.

item.title: Ninth woman's body found as South African police investigate string of deaths
item.description: South Africa police have cautioned against assuming that all the killings are linked but many women are afraid.

item.title: UN experts say grounds to believe US committed war crimes in Iran strikes
item.description: The US has not acknowledged carrying out February's deadly strikes on a primary school in Minab and a sports complex in Lamerd.
